How do SEC operating companies divide by filer status, from large accelerated filers down?

SELECT category, count(*) AS companies, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE entitytype = 'operating' AND category <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which counties produced the largest GDP in 2024?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many awards does a Grants.gov opportunity expect to make on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis WHERE try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double) > 0
Which grid operators reached the highest peak demand in 2023?
SELECT balancing_authority, max(try_cast(demand_mw AS double)) AS peak_mw FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much of public school funding came from federal, state and local sources in fiscal 2017?

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(greatest(try_cast(tfedrev AS double), 0)) / sum(greatest(try_cast(totalrev AS double), 0)), 1) AS federal_pct, round(100.0 * sum(greatest(try_cast(tstrev AS double), 0)) / sum(greatest(try_cast(totalrev AS double), 0)), 1) AS state_pct, round(100.0 * sum(greatest(try_cast(tlocrev AS double), 0)) / sum(greatest(try_cast(totalrev AS double), 0)), 1) AS local_pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17'
Which manufacturers have issued the most recall campaigns?
SELECT mfgname, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Is more money passed down as sub-grants or as sub-contracts?
SELECT subaward_type, sum(try_cast(subaward_amount AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_subaward_search GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In which states did Medicare pay the most per heart failure hospital stay in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, round(sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double) * try_cast(avg_mdcr_pymt_amt AS double)) / sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double))) AS avg_payment FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_cd = '291' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published patent applications contributed reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications
Which grid operators generated the most electricity from natural gas in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_natural_gas AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Medicaid prescriptions were filled in New York in 2021?
SELECT sum(try_cast(number_of_prescriptions AS double)) AS prescriptions FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' AND state = 'NY'
Which power plants on the national map have the largest operating capacity?
SELECT name, try_cast(oper_cap AS double) AS capacity_mw FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much have benefit plans reported paying insurance brokers in commissions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(ins_broker_comm_pd_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_a_part1
Which countries were the biggest buyers of American soybeans in 2023?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_exports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '1201%' AND d.year = '2023' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the date of the latest published patent application on file?
Which states have the highest median gross rent?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_rent FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.variable = 'B25064_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many proposed rules did the Environmental Protection Agency publish in 2021?
SELECT count(*) AS proposed_rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE agency LIKE '%ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY%' AND doc_type = '"PRORULE"' AND issue_date LIKE '"2021-%'
Which steps are recorded most often in EPA enforcement cases?
SELECT sub_activity_type_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_milestones WHERE sub_activity_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many sections of Texas law are recorded as repealed?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'tx' AND act_status = 'repealed'
Which New York plants have the largest generating capacity?

SELECT plant_name, round(sum(mw)) AS capacity_mw FROM (SELECT plant_code, plant_name, generator_id, max(try_cast(nameplate_capacity_mw AS double)) AS mw FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE state = 'NY' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median household income in Kings County, New York, in the 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36047' AND variable = 'B19013_E001'
Which states have the most judicial positions on record?
SELECT location_state, count(*) AS positions FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE position_type = 'jud' AND coalesce(location_state, '') <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people filed to run for president in 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'P' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Which hospitals treated the most Medicare patients for sepsis in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT rndrng_prvdr_org_name AS hospital, rndrng_prvdr_state_abrvtn AS state, sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double)) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' AND drg_desc LIKE 'SEPTICEMIA%' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average molecular mass of a compound in PubChem?
SELECT avg(try_cast(c2 AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass
Which NIH institutes gave out the most grant money in fiscal year 2023?
SELECT ic_name, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many power plants report a coal ash impoundment?
SELECT count(DISTINCT plant_code) AS plants FROM govblock_energy.eia860_plant_y_sheet_plant WHERE ash_impoundment = 'Y'
Which banks earned the most net income in 2024?
SELECT name, try_cast(netinc AS double) AS net_income_thousands FROM govblock_finance.fdic_financials WHERE cast(repdte AS varchar) = '20241231' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many offshore wind turbines are operating in U.S. waters?
SELECT count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(t_offshore AS varchar) = '1'
